name: Veritas
source: CRON 20261014: Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc unaudited consolidated financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group 2026 column, N'000 scaled to naira. Profit before taxation less Taxation equals the printed Profit after taxation. The filing's EPS line is labelled kobo but both its 2026 and 2025 columns reproduce naira per share against the stated profit and share count, so 0.13 is stored as a loss per share. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | gaps filled from stockanalysis.com only where the source row reproduced an already stored figure of the SAME row within 1.5 percent of the stored value | CRON 20260929_195546: profit before tax and net profit corrected for the restated 2024 and 2023 columns of the FY2025 five year financial summary; the file previously mixed figures from an earlier presentation. Profit before tax less tax equals profit after tax for all five years.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: profit before taxation less profit after taxation as printed on the five year financial summary FY2025, in NGN thousand: 144,939 / (465,319) / 231,984 / 70,240 / 118,465. FY2021 previously held the profit after tax figure.
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity PINNED (filing): row stored uniformly negative, and the file carries neither Gross Profit nor EBIT so the identity can never test it; the FY2025 audited statements (note 35 Other operating expenses) print it as a bracketed deduction of the same magnitude, so the value is the filing's own and the sign is the artefact, and the column ties with it positive
